identity.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF Tokenized bStocks

about.description: EWYB is a tokenized certificate issued by BTECH Holdings Limited (ADGM) that provides economic exposure to iShares MSCI South Korea ETF. iShares MSCI South Korea ETF seeks to track the investment results of an index composed of South Korean equities, providing exposure to large- and mid-cap Korean companies. Each token is backed 1 to 1 by a corresponding ETF unit held in a segregated custody account with a regulated custodian under ADGM FSRA Ledger-Based Securities rules. EWYB is admitted to the ADGM Official List of Securities. Convertibility to real units is available via the Binance-affiliated broker-dealer Nest Trading Limited, and distribution value is delivered through an on-chain Multiplier rebasing mechanism at the bStocks framework level. Aggregate proof of collateral is published on the Binance Proof of Collateral dashboard covering the entire bStocks family. Access is restricted from United States persons.
